Customer Identity Verification (KYC) Policy

Document ID: Policy_C17_kyc_policy

Category: C17 — KYC & Identity Verification

Department: Compliance

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

Establishes the mandatory identity verification standards for new connections and periodic re-verification, in line with applicable telecom licensing and regulatory requirements.

2. Accepted Documents

Aadhaar (with explicit consent for e-KYC)

Passport

Voter ID

Driving Licence

3. Policy Statements

No connection may be activated without completed KYC verification.

Periodic re-verification may be mandated by regulatory directive; non-completion within the notified window results in service suspension.

KYC records are retained per the statutory minimum retention period even after account closure.
